column3: NASB adds “He is the one whom”; “by the right hand” is rendered “to His right hand,” and “give” is “grant.”
NASB follows the critical text; “declarations” is rendered “things,” and it adds “so is.”
NASB follows the critical text; “felt cut up” is rendered “were cut to the quick,” and “execute” is “slay.”
NASB follows the critical text; it reorders the verse and renders “honored” as “respected.”
NASB renders “take heed to yourselves” as “take care.”
NASB follows the critical text; it renders “before these days” as “some time ago” and “were persuaded by” as “followed.”
NASB renders “registration” as “census” and “significant number of people” as “some people.” It adds “too.”
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “in the present case,” and “work” is rendered “action.”
NASB follows the critical text; it moves “They were persuaded by him,” which ends this verse in the Greek, to v. 40. A stray quotation mark appears in the NASB text.
NASB begins with “they took his advice” from v. 39; it follows the critical text, and “having beaten” is rendered “flogged.”
NASB follows the critical text; “dishonor” is rendered “shame.”
NASB renders “in house” as “from house to house” and “not ceasing” as “kept right on.”
